name: brightdata
description: Search the web and read public pages live with Bright Data.

interface.shortDescription: Search and read the live web
interface.longDescription:
Bright Data brings live public web data into ChatGPT and Codex.

Search the web: get live search results for one query or a batch of queries.

Read pages: open public pages live, at the moment you ask, so answers use the page as it is right now. Get them as clean markdown, one page or several at a time.

Sign in with your Bright Data account to start. Requests run on your account.
defaultPrompt: What are the top 10 stories on https://news.ycombinator.com right now, with points? Use Bright Data.
What's the newest Python release on https://www.python.org/downloads/? Use Bright Data.
Compare the plans and prices on https://vercel.com/pricing and https://www.netlify.com/pricing/. Use Bright Data.

positive.description: Answer a question from one live web search
positive.prompt: Use Bright Data to search the web for the official website of the Rust programming language, and give me the URL.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_engine once and gives the official Rust website, rust-lang.org, from the returned results.

positive.description: Several live web searches at once
positive.prompt: Use Bright Data to search the web for the official websites of the Python programming language, the Rust programming language and Node.js in one call, and give me each URL.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_engine_batch with the three searches and gives python.org, rust-lang.org and nodejs.org.

positive.description: Answer a question from one public page
positive.prompt: Use Bright Data to read https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases and tell me which Node.js versions are marked LTS.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls scrape_as_markdown with the URL and lists the Node.js versions the page marks as LTS.

positive.description: Find a fact on one public page
positive.prompt: What's the newest Python release on https://www.python.org/downloads/? Use Bright Data.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls scrape_as_markdown with the URL and names the newest Python release shown on the page.

positive.description: Read two public pages at once
positive.prompt: With Bright Data, read https://example.com and https://www.iana.org/domains/reserved in one call and summarize each page in two sentences.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls scrape_batch with both URLs and summarizes each page from the returned markdown.

negative.description: Creative writing needs no web data
negative.prompt: Write a haiku about autumn leaves.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers directly without calling any Bright Data tool.
Answers directly (391) without calling any Bright Data tool.

negative.prompt: Translate 'good morning, see you tomorrow' into Spanish.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers directly with the Spanish translation without calling any Bright Data tool.

publication.release_notes: Long pages can now be read in full. A page over 40,000 characters comes back cut, with a next field; calling scrape_as_markdown again with it returns the following part of the same copy of the page at no extra cost. scrape_batch now returns up to 40,000 characters in total, shared between its pages. The skill explains both. Sign in with OAuth using a Bright Data account; a test account for review is provided in the submission form.
